Title: Data Scientist – Consultant
Description: Data Scientist – Consultant - Americas Delivery Mexico (ADMX) Are you an experienced, passionate pioneer in technology? A Data Scientist who wants to work in a collaborative environment? As an experienced Data Scientist, you will have the ability to share new ideas and collaborate on projects as a consultant without the extensive demands of travel. Americas Delivery Mexico (ADMX) leverages scale and talent to provide high quality, cost-effective service to our clients. ADMX is a member of the Global Delivery Network which has presence across the world with Delivery centers in the United States, Romania, India, Spain, China, and the Philippines. ADMX is in Queretaro, Mexico. We provide consulting services to help our clients achieve a higher level of service in operational efficiency and business value. We are a team of professionals passionate about serving clients with distinction and learning, and we are driven by our purpose: Making an impact that matters for our clients, our people, and society. Work you’ll do/Responsibilities As a Consultant at Deloitte, you will work within an engagement team and be responsible for supporting the overall project goals and objectives. In this role, you will interact with stakeholders and cross-functional teams. It is expected that you will be able to perform independent tasks as well as provide technical guidance to team members, as needed. Supports analytical and modeling work under the guidance of senior data scientists. Learns statistical fundamentals, data preparation techniques, and model evaluation practices while delivering on well-defined analytical tasks. Prepares, cleans, and transforms datasets for analysis and model development. Implements descriptive and exploratory analysis using Python and relevant libraries (pandas, NumPy, matplotlib). Trains and evaluates baseline ML models using established frameworks (scikit-learn, XGBoost). Builds and maintains dashboards and visualizations to communicate analytical findings. Supports cloud-based model deployment and monitoring under senior guidance. Documents experiments, assumptions, and findings in a reproducible format. The Team Join our AI & Engineering team in transforming technology platforms, driving innovation, and helping make a significant impact on our clients' success. You’ll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that are critical to business. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation. AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These solutions are powered by engineering for business advantage, transforming mission-critical operations. We enable clients to stay ahead with the latest advancements by transforming engineering teams and modernizing technology & data platforms. Our delivery models are tailored to meet each client's unique requirements. Qualifications Required 3-5 years of consulting and/or industry experience Completion of course of study/Egresado in Computer Science/IT/Computer Engineering, or any pertinent field or industry, or equivalent years of experience. Advanced English level Python Proficient; writes modular, production-ready code; builds reusable ML pipelines; applies testing best practices (pytest). BI / Analytics: Proficient in BI tools (Power BI, Tableau, Looker); designs semantic layers; builds self-service reporting assets; strong SQL skills. Cloud AI (AWS/GCP/Azure): Proficient on at least one cloud AI platform; designs MLOps pipelines (training, registry, serving, monitoring); familiar with managed AI services. ML / Modeling: Strong hands-on experience with tree-based models, neural networks, NLP, or time-series; implements hyperparameter tuning and cross-validation rigorously. Statistics: Applied experience with regression analysis, Bayesian methods, hypothesis testing, and causal inference techniques. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in Mexico at the time of hire; limited sponsorship may be available for this role based on business needs and applicable law. Preferred DevOps / CI-CD Familiar with Git workflows and basic CI/CD for model code; understands containerization (Docker) for model packaging. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you. Our people and culture Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ideas and perspectives and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our client most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work. Professional development From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe there’s always room to learn. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership opportunities and connect and grow through mentorship. From on-the-job learning experiences to formal development programs, our professionals have a variety of opportunities to continue to grow throughout their career. Strong proficiency in C++ and Python, including performance optimisation, memory management, data structures, and algorithms. Ability to optimise Computer Vision or machine learning workloads for GPU and high-performance computing environments. Experience with Docker, CI/CD, and cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP. Ability to work with large datasets and design robust evaluation methodologies, metrics, and validation workflows. Strong software engineering practices, including code reviews, version control, automated testing, debugging, and profiling. Fluency in Spanish and English. Legally entitled to work in Mexico. Highly Regarded Qualifications And Experience Experience with geospatial applications, coordinate systems, spatial analysis, or large-scale mapping workflows. Experience with autonomous systems, robotics, drones, or multi-sensor platforms. Experience in mining, construction, autonomous systems, robotics, or other industrial environments. We advance the mining industry towards a safer, more efficient, and more sustainable future through the delivery of innovative software solutions and deep domain mining expertise. Guided by our underlying principles of mining expertise, innovation, and sustainability, we strive to create safer and more efficient operations for our mining customers. Our focus on providing advanced mining enterprise technology and training across the mining lifecycle enables us to guide customers through the industry's current and emerging challenges worldwide. This includes helping them meet the shift in social norms and consumer and investor ESG-related expectations. Please, no agencies or recruiters.

Title: Senior Consultant
Description: About the Role We are seeking a Lead AI/ML Engineer to architect, build, and operationalize a full-lifecycle, automated evaluation harness for non-deterministic Generative AI agents deployed across our Cloud GTM space (e.g., deep research, conversational analytics, pipeline forecasting). In this role, you will transition our AI evaluations from manual human reviews to high-throughput automated pipelines backed by LLM-as-a-Judge and targeted human audits. You will work at the intersection of enterprise software engineering, distributed computing, and cutting-edge LLM evaluation frameworks to ensure data integrity, eliminate regressions, and scale our GTM agent capabilities. Key Responsibilities Foundations & Local Sandbox Development Build robust golden datasets extracted from UAT logs and utilize frontier models to synthetically generate variations (typos, phrasing, syntax) for robust testing. Construct local developer sandbox environments using the Google ADK framework with version-controlled prompts in Cider. Generate test scripts and code snippets mapped to defined success metrics for continuous local unit testing. Production Pipeline Automation & System Architecture Architect and deploy language-agnostic RPC endpoints to systematically invoke GTM agents within the ecosystem. Build resilient production pipelines supporting parallel inference execution across 1,000+ trajectory datasets in under 15 minutes. Stand up a centralized Model Context Protocol (MCP) logging server to capture raw prompts, tool trajectories, SQL queries, and token costs using strict JSON schemas. Implement asynchronous message queues (Pub/Sub) for rate-limiting/backpressure, along with retry policies for network and generation failures. Establish CI/CD Pull Request (PR) gates that block commits causing capability regressions, and enable pre-production shadow deployments using production mirror traffic. Skill Benchmarking & Trajectory Validation Author eval test suites to isolate specific agent competencies (e.g., CRM writes, SQL analytics). Inject sandboxed mocks to validate tool-calling logic without producing live CRM side effects or executing heavy database reads. Validate multi-turn trajectories, checking chronological tool order, API loop prevention, and exact parameter payload assertions (e.g., date ranges, seller regions). Stream execution logs for baseline delta analysis and capability scoring. Enterprise Analytics, Go

Title: AI Algorithm Research Intern – Neuromorphic Computing
Description: Job Details Job Description: For nearly a decade, Intel's Neuromorphic Computing Lab-together with a global ecosystem of 250+ research groups-has explored architectures, algorithms, and software inspired by the brain's extraordinary efficiency, scalability, and adaptability. Our Loihi series of research chips pioneered event-driven, sparse, and massively parallel neuro-inspired processing, fueling over 100 peer-reviewed publications that validate the promise of this novel approach. Now, we're entering an exciting new chapter: transforming these breakthroughs into real-world products that will power the coming era of physical AI systems-beyond the reach of GPUs and mainstream AI accelerators. If you are passionate about pushing the boundaries of computing, from transistor-level innovation to software abstractions, join us. Help define the next wave of AI technology that harnesses the proven advantages of Intel's neuromorphic computing technology with the versatility demanded by modern AI workloads. About The Organization As part of Intel's CTO Office, you will join a vertically integrated incubation effort dedicated to bringing Intel's neuromorphic technology innovations to market. Our diverse team of engineers and researchers have pioneered sparse, event-based, neuromorphic architecture over multiple generations and is now focused on commercializing the technology in future Intel and partner products. Position Overview Demonstrate the value of Intel's neuromorphic technologies by developing, implementing and benchmarking algorithms for Intel's next generation neuromorphic architecture to enable applications in edge computing, signal processing and autonomous systems for the era of physical AI with groundbreaking performance and efficiency. Responsibilities Support the development and benchmarking of applications on Intel's next-generation neuromorphic architecture. Author and publish results in top-tier conferences/journals. Contribute to Intel's neuromorphic SDK with documentation, code reviews, and continuous improvement of software processes. Qualifications Minimum qualifications are required to be initially considered for this position. Enrolled in an MSc or PhD program in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, Physics, or a related field. 3+ years of experience writing clean, efficient and modular Python and C++ code. 2+ years of experience with deep/machine learning, mathematical optimization, and AI frameworks (PyTorch, JAX, TensorFlow). 1+ years of experience developing AI models for perception, reasoning, and control (e.g., YOLO, LLMs, or VLAs based on transformer or SSM architectures) 1+ years of experience with software development best practices (OO design, testing, debugging, documentation, version control, code reviews). Intermediate to Advanced English level Must have unrestricted - permanent right to work in Mexico (this position is not eligible for employment-based visa/immigration sponsorship). Preferred qualifications are in addition to the minimum requirements and are considered a plus factor in identifying top candidates. Experience with edge AI HW accelerators or event-based sensors. Experience in developing software for robotics or other real-time control systems. Experience with profiling and benchmarking algorithms and hardware architectures. A candidate who accepts an offer of employment in Mexico is required to present their own personal identification information and numbers for the following: Mexican Security Number (NSS), Tax Identification Number (RFC) and CURP identification number. Description: Why WWT? At World Wide Technology, we work together to make a new world happen. Our important work benefits our clients and partners as much as it does our people and communities across the globe. WWT is dedicated to achieving its mission of creating a profitable growth company that is also a Great Place to Work for All. We achieve this through our world-class culture, generous benefits and by delivering cutting-edge technology solutions for our clients. Founded in 1990, WWT is a global technology solutions provider leading the AI and Digital Revolution. WWT combines the power of strategy, execution and partnership to accelerate digital transformational outcomes for organizations around the globe. Through its Advanced Technology Center, a collaborative ecosystem of the world's most advanced hardware and software solutions, WWT helps clients and partners conceptualize, test and validate innovative technology solutions for the best business outcomes and then deploys them at scale through its global warehousing, distribution and integration capabilities. With over 12,000 employees across WWT and Softchoice and more than 60 locations around the world, WWT's culture, built on a set of core values and established leadership philosophies, has been recognized 14 years in a row by Fortune and Great Place to Work® for its unique blend of determination, innovation and creating a great place to work for all. Want to work with highly motivated individuals on high-performance teams? Join WWT today! Roles Overview: The Business Product Analyst supports the discovery, evaluation, validation, and scaling of field-led AI innovations across the Sales organization. Working closely with the Business Product Manager, sellers, citizen developers, technology teams, and cross-functional partners, this role helps identify high-value AI use cases and determine which innovations have the potential to scale beyond an individual team or workflow. The role focuses on AI use-case discovery, business value assessment, product validation, prioritization, adoption, and measurement, helping transform promising field-developed solutions into trusted, reusable AI capabilities that can deliver broader organizational value. Core Accountability: Accountable for supporting the intake, assessment, validation, prioritization, and adoption of field-led AI use cases, ensuring promising innovations are evaluated against defined business value, feasibility, scalability, user experience, and enterprise-readiness criteria. This role helps move AI innovations from idea or prototype to validated business capability, while maintaining visibility into the broader AI portfolio and its measurable impact. Why This Role Matters: AI innovation is increasingly happening within the field, but valuable solutions can remain siloed, duplicate existing capabilities, or lack a path to scale. This role supports the creation of path to turn field innovation into scalable business capabilities. Helps identify the most valuable opportunities, validate their impact, and provide the insights needed to prioritize investment and scale solutions that improve seller productivity and business outcomes. What will you be doing? Responsibilities: Innovation Discovery and Assessment Support the full product lifecycle: discovery → design → delivery → launch → adoption → optimization, and ongoing improvement. Partner with delivery teams to translate business requirements into scalable product solutions. Support intake and discovery of field-developed AI ideas, tools, agents, and automations. Define the business problem, target users, workflow, and expected value. Assess opportunities based on business value, adoption potential, complexity, scalability, and duplication. Identify common use cases that could be reused or scaled across Sales. AI Product Validation and Field Feedback Establish and maintain feedback loops with sellers, users, and citizen developers. Gather, analyze, and evaluate field feedback, usage patterns, and user needs to identify trends, gaps, and opportunities. Validate AI capabilities against business requirements, seller workflows, and intended outcomes. Translate findings into actionable requirements and recommendations for product improvements. Pilot, Adoption & Business Value Support pilots and phased rollouts for capabilities selected for scale. Track and analyze adoption, usage, productivity, and business-value metrics. Identify adoption barriers and recommend actions to improve the user experience and sustain adoption. Support enablement and change activities required for successful rollout. Portfolio & Product Execution Maintain visibility into assigned AI initiatives, status, dependencies, adoption, and outcomes. Support requirements, backlog, prioritization, and release-readiness activities. Identify opportunities to consolidate or connect field innovations with existing enterprise AI capabilities. Provide data- and field-informed insights to support roadmap, prioritization, and investment decisions. Change Management, Adoption & Enablement Support change management strategies and plans for new or evolving AI capabilities. Assess change impacts, stakeholder needs, adoption barriers, and readiness. Partner with product, enablement, and business teams on communications, training, and adoption activities. Monitor adoption and field sentiment to identify where additional intervention or reinforcement is needed , Qualifications: Required 3 - 5 years of experience in product analysis, business analysis, sales operations, technology enablement, innovation, or a related role. Experience supporting digital products, platforms, automation, or workflow solutions. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to gather and synthesize user feedback and data into actionable insights. Ability to translate business problems and field needs into structured requirements and recommendations. Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills. Experience supporting product adoption, change management, or enablement activities. Familiarity with sales workflows and enterprise platforms such as CRM and productivity tools. Experience working in Agile, product delivery, process improvement, or change-management environments. Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Technology, Data/Analytics, Product Management, or a related field Preferred Experience with AI-enabled tools, including LLMs, copilots, AI agents, automation, Claude or analytics. Experience supporting AI use cases from idea or prototype through pilot and adoption. Experience with innovation programs, product intake, portfolio prioritization, or citizen development. Experience analyzing product adoption, user feedback, productivity improvements, or business outcomes. Relevant product, Agile, process improvement, or change-management certifications (e.g., CSPO, Lean Six Sigma, Prosci). Want to learn more about WWT? La posición no está orientada a ejecutar técnicamente el detalle de plataformas, integraciones o modelos de AI, sino a gobernar, priorizar, cuestionar, orquestar y asegurar generación de valor mediante datos e inteligencia artificial. Funciones del puesto Modelo Operativo de Datos & AI Diseñar e implantar el modelo operativo de Datos & AI de la Cía, definiendo roles, responsabilidades, derechos de decisión, foros de gobierno, procesos e interacción con las áreas de negocio. Definir la distribución de capacidades entre equipo interno, corporativo, proveedores, consultoras e integradores. Establecer mecanismos de intake, evaluación, priorización, diseño, ejecución, adopción y seguimiento de beneficios de iniciativas de datos y AI. Asegurar la evolución continua del capability de Datos & AI de acuerdo con las necesidades del negocio y la madurez organizacional. Estrategia de Datos, AI y Valor de Negocio Definir y gestionar la estrategia y roadmap de capacidades de datos e inteligencia artificial, alineando prioridades de negocio, operación, transformación digital y lineamientos corporativos. Priorizar y decidir sobre casos de uso de datos, analítica, automatización e inteligencia artificial con base en valor de negocio, factibilidad, riesgos, madurez de datos y capacidad de adopción. Asegurar que las iniciativas de datos y AI contribuyan a eficiencia operativa, trazabilidad, toma de decisiones, reducción de manualidad, mejora de procesos y generación de capacidades diferenciales para la Cïa Estructurar business cases y establecer mecanismos de seguimiento de beneficios, adopción, baseline antes/después y valor realizado. Gobierno de Integración y Flujo de Información Gobernar la integración entre plataformas operacionales y corporativas como habilitador del flujo confiable de información, asegurando alineación con necesidades de negocio, arquitectura, seguridad y operación. Liderar y gobernar, con Arquitectura, Seguridad, Operaciones TI, proveedores e integradores, la priorización e implementación de patrones de integración, APIs, flujos de datos y mecanismos de interoperabilidad definidos por la compañía. Aprobar prioridades funcionales y escalar dependencias, riesgos, desempeño, continuidad y evolución de integraciones críticas, sin sustituir las responsabilidades técnicas especializadas de Arquitectura u Operaciones TI. Gobierno, Calidad y Consumo de Datos Liderar el gobierno de datos de la Cía, estableciendo ownership, stewardship, catálogo, linaje, calidad, definición de datos críticos, reglas de consumo y foros de decisión con participación activa de las áreas de negocio. Asegurar que las áreas operativas y corporativas cuenten con datos confiables, trazables, oportunos y adecuados para toma de decisiones, operación, analítica, reporting y casos de uso de AI. Gobernar modelos de consumo eficiente de datos, incluyendo capacidades self-service, productos de datos, analítica corporativa y adopción por analistas, power users y áreas de negocio. Inteligencia Artificial y Analítica Avanzada Identificar, estructurar y priorizar casos de uso de inteligencia artificial, automatización y analítica avanzada alineados a objetivos operativos, financieros, comerciales y de eficiencia organizacional. Liderar y gobernar la evaluación, priorización, implementación y adopción de soluciones de AI, articulando a las áreas de negocio, Arquitectura, Seguridad, Operaciones TI, proveedores y consultores especializados. Asegurar que los casos de uso de AI cuenten con datos confiables, criterios de seguridad, privacidad, trazabilidad, gobierno, medición de beneficios y uso responsable. Integración Negocio – Tecnología Actuar como socio estratégico de las áreas operativas y corporativas, traduciendo necesidades de negocio en capacidades de datos, integración, analítica e inteligencia artificial. Gestionar y decidir sobre demanda, priorización, roadmap, adopción y beneficios de iniciativas data-driven, asegurando claridad de alcance, sponsorship, ownership de negocio y viabilidad tecnológica. Proveer visibilidad continua sobre valor generado, riesgos, adopción, madurez de datos y evolución de capacidades de datos, integración y AI. Liderazgo y Desarrollo Organizacional Liderar y desarrollar capacidades internas de gestión de datos, gobierno, analítica, integración y AI, definiendo el modelo de colaboración con especialistas internos y externos. Fomentar una cultura de colaboración, ownership de datos, adopción de capacidades basadas en información, uso responsable de AI y mejora continua en el consumo de datos por parte del negocio. Gestión Financiera y Gobierno Asegurar la correcta planeación, ejecución y control del presupuesto asociado a capacidades de datos, integración, analítica, inteligencia artificial y servicios tecnológicos relacionados, optimizando recursos y alineando inversiones a prioridades estratégicas y casos de valor. Asegurar cumplimiento de políticas, estándares y lineamientos internos, regulatorios y corporativos aplicables a datos, integración, seguridad, privacidad, gobierno de información y uso responsable de AI.
